title: Order the Log Pipeline
story: A tiny pipeline counts the error lines in a log. Put it in order.
goal: Put the lines in order so the program prints 2.
starter:
lines = log.split("\n")
log = "ok\nerror a\nok\nerror b"
errors = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("error")]
print(len(errors))
lines: errors = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("error")]
hints: Each line uses the variable made by the line before it.
log first, then lines, then errors, then print.

solution:
log = "ok\nerror a\nok\nerror b"
lines = log.split("\n")
errors = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("error")]
print(len(errors))
